cmd:
cd /tmp
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Chrome/120"
echo "--- help tail (quota)"
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" "https://www.ogimet.com/getbufr_help.phtml.en" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
t=sys.stdin.read(); t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t,flags=re.S); t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t)); t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t)
i=t.find('quota'); print(t[i-60:i+1800])"
sleep 2
echo "--- list ecenter UKMS type IS 06Z"
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" -w "\nhttp=%{http_code}\n" "https://www.ogimet.com/getbufr.php?res=list&beg=202610060300&end=202610060300&ecenter=UKMS&type=IS" | head -c 2200
sleep 2
echo "--- same, with Referer"
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" -e "https://www.ogimet.com/bufr.phtml.en" -w "\nhttp=%{http_code}\n" "https://www.ogimet.com/getbufr.php?res=list&beg=202610060300&end=202610060300&ecenter=UKMS&type=IS" | head -c 600
